title: DEXPort
tagline: Make history of DEX trader transparent.  Learn, improve and share with your friends
description:
The project aims to show transactions on the wallet as the history of results, indicators, and other analytics
So Dexport is sort of validator of trades performance

It's very useful for the trader
- he can learn from them
- share with his audience
- spend less time on raising funds for management

For the investor this solution is also good.
He can see track of record, verify the trader and reduce risks of investing
how_its_made:
Frontend: typescript, react, nextjs, mui

Vercel for hosting

Backend: typesctipt, nestjs, moralis, uniswap, thegraph

hosted on aws ec2        

Used polygon as network around all project

Moralis to get all transactions history

The graph + Uniswap to get prices history from blockchain



All these tools are amazing. I really enjoyed it.  

Front: https://github.com/RusDyn/dexpot_front

Back: https://github.com/RusDyn/dex_portfolio
